TRIMAW-SUPER_SPECIAL.title: Super Special
TRIMAW-PREP.title: Prep
TRIMAW-PREP.description: Ready a [color=#ff9047]Morsel[/color]. If you have [blue]4[/blue], you automatically make a [gold]Snack[/gold] card from [blue]2-4[/blue] of them.
TRIMAW-BREAD.title: Bread
TRIMAW-BREAD.description: Makes [gold]Snacks[/gold] that add [gold]Energy[/gold] and reduce costs.
TRIMAW-MEAT.title: Meat
TRIMAW-MEAT.description: Makes [gold]Snacks[/gold] that help you attack the enemy.
TRIMAW-SHROOMS.title: Shrooms
TRIMAW-BERRIES.title: Berries
TRIMAW-PEPPER.title: Pepper
TRIMAW-PEPPER.description: Makes [gold]Snacks[/gold] that give offensive and defensive buffs.
TRIMAW-WATER.title: Water
TRIMAW-WATER.description: Makes [gold]Snacks[/gold] that move cards from [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] to [gold]Hand[/gold].
TRIMAW-IMAGINE.title: Imagine
TRIMAW-IMAGINE.description: Conjure up a [color=#50d6d6]Figment[/color] and heal it by your [gold]Vigor[/gold]. If you already had {Limit:plural:[blue]1[/blue] [color=#50d6d6]Figment[/color]|[blue]{}[/blue] [color=#50d6d6]Figments[/color]}, the oldest [gold]Pops[/gold].
TRIMAW-POP.title: Pop
TRIMAW-POP.description: For a [color=#50d6d6]Figment[/color] to use its intended move, split its current HP between your other [color=#50d6d6]Figments[/color], and leave.
TRIMAW-DUCK_LORD_ASSOCIATE.title: Duck Lord Associate
TRIMAW-DUCK_LORD_ASSOCIATE.description: These guys love money! Maybe they'll be stronger if you have more [gold]Gold[/gold]?
TRIMAW-EUNECTES.title: Eunectes
TRIMAW-EUNECTES.description: She's chief of one of the jungle tribes and built a REALLY BIG robot. Let's help her rebuild it!
